raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (349 rows, all tagged source_tz='UTC') has txn_ts in UTC, while the other batches are America/Chicago local time. Those rows were loaded without conversion, which shifts them about 6 hours late and pushes roughly 99 evening transactions from 2026-01-16 into the 2026-01-17 00:00-06:00 window and inflates that day's volume.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN (CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN (CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
